configs.description: The chassis with two AC supplies and two fan modules fitted, front-to-rear air, before any part number: the shape every build below starts from.

configs.description: Two DC supplies and front-to-rear air: PWR-511-DC-RED supplies and FAN-7011M-F fan modules. The data sheet lists no DC part number for the switch; the supplies are spares, and a DC build is ordered through the "#" configurable SKU.
configs.name: dc-f

configs.description: Two DC supplies and rear-to-front air: PWR-511-DC-BLUE supplies and FAN-7011M-R fan modules. No DC part number is listed for the switch.
configs.name: dc-r

configs.description: The 7050TX3-48C8 with two AC supplies and front-to-rear air: PWR-511-AC-RED supplies and FAN-7011M-F fan modules, all with red handles. Ordered as DCS-7050TX3-48C8-F.
configs.name: f

configs.description: The 7050TX3-48C8 with two AC supplies and rear-to-front air: PWR-511-AC-BLUE supplies and FAN-7011M-R fan modules, all with blue handles. Ordered as DCS-7050TX3-48C8-R.
configs.name: r

gaps.note: Guide Table 1 gives a depth of 46.7 cm (18.4 in) and the data sheet 46.8 cm. The guide's is modelled; the difference is 1 mm.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of which is current.

gaps.note: Storage temperature -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2) against -40 to 70 C (data sheet). The guide's is in attrs.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of which is current.

gaps.note: The guide draws four generic rear panels (Figures D-1 to D-4) and does not say which model uses which. The 7050TX3-48C8 is mapped to D-3 by its fan count (two, data sheet), its two supplies and its rear management ports. The data sheet's "Rear View" photograph (PDF page 3) for the 7050TX3-48C8 and its siblings shows the same shape but is a thumbnail.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of the rear panel of the 7050TX3-48C8.

gaps.note: The guide's Figures 3-1 to 3-14 are isometric drawings with no measure and the kit guides for KIT-7001, KIT-7101 and the other spares are not held, so no ear position or rail kit is written.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the mounting bracket position, and the kit guides.

gaps.note: Figure C-17 is too small to resolve any per-port lamp, so none is modelled and the port lamp states of guide Appendix A.1.2 are not attached to a port.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the lit face.

gaps.note: The small blue port numbers under the jack rows, the legends on the QSFP band, the system and fan lamp glyphs and the PS1 and PS2 legends are unreadable or barely readable in the 576 px figure. The glyphs and the two PS legends are drawn as read; the rest is not drawn.

Which side the latches of the stacked cages and the key of the stacked jacks face is not visible in the figure. The library's belly-to-belly convention is used (upper QSFP cage upright, lower turned 180; the upper jack turned 180).
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the stacked ports.

gaps.note: The management block's console symbol is drawn as the 7280SR3-48YC8 draws it; the figure resolves the block only as three stacked ports.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the rear management block.

gaps.note: The guide's Figure D-3 draws one generic supply; the PWR-511-AC and PWR-511-DC components are the library's, drawn from the 7280 guide's figure. The PWR-511-DC is the AC housing with a plain two-pole terminal block.
gaps.wanted: a flat drawing or photograph of the PWR-511-AC and PWR-511-DC.

gaps.note: The guide's power tables and the data sheet give whole-switch figures only; the fan modules' missing power figure (lint L27) stands. The supplies state their output.
Guide Table 5 gives the 7050TX3-48C8 KIT-GND-EXT-1RU, attached on the bottom of the chassis. No flat figure measures a grounding point, so none is placed.
gaps.wanted: a flat drawing of the bottom with the grounding bracket holes.

chassis.note: Guide Table 1: 48.3 x 4.4 x 46.7 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.4 inches), 9.4 kg (20.6 lbs). Data sheet: 44 x 4.4 x 46.8 cm, 20.6 lbs (9.36 kg). The width: 48.3 cm is over the mounting ears, so the body between them, which is what is modelled, is the data sheet's 44 cm (440.0 here). The height is 43.7, as the library's other 7050 devices. The depth is the guide's 46.7 cm (467.0); the data sheet's 46.8 cm is 1 mm more, the gap `depth`. The weights agree (9.4 kg and 9.36 kg). 1RU.

colour.note: The front plate is the median of the grey pixels (neither black nor white, low saturation) of the guide's figure C-17, #828384. The figure is a raster and its lighting is not known, so the shade is estimated.

configurations.note: Data sheet ordering information: DCS-7050TX3-48C8-F and -R ("48x10GBaseT & 8x100GbE QSFP100 switch, front-to-rear air, 2xAC" and "rear-to-front air, 2xAC"). The "#" SKU is an order of parts, not a part number a DCIM can hold, and is not listed. The data sheet lists no DC build of the switch: the DC configurations are examples with no part number.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED. The guide's Chapter 3 mounts the switch with the accessory-kit brackets and shows them in isometric drawings that carry no measure, and the kit guides are not held. Recorded in the gap rack-ears.

environment.note: Guide Table 2: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -25 to 70 C, altitude 0 to 3,000 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing. Data sheet: storage -40 to 70 C. The storage temperature differs: gap `environment`, the guide's used.

front-legend.note: The figure prints the maker's wordmark and the model line at the top left. THE WORDMARK IS NOT DRAWN: a logo-zone region is reserved over it and the plain model text is set.

front-ports.note: Figure C-17 at about 1.277 px/mm. Forty-eight RJ-45 jacks in two stacked rows (ports 1 to 48), twelve columns on each side of the QSFP block, in blocks of six columns on the registry's 13.97 mm ganged-jack pitch (the figure reads 13.9); the tab centres of ports 1, 13, 25 and 37 read 12.3, 101.6, 270.4 and 358.7 mm, so the four blocks start at 5.95, 95.2, 264.0 and 352.4 mm, a block step of about 89 mm (a 5.1 mm gap between blocks of 83.8 mm). The jacks are the library's stacked RJ-45 of arista/7280tr3-40c6 (rows 14.5 mm apart from 9.1 mm down), whose figure draws the same two rows; this figure's tabs sit outside the jacks and the rows are not resolved to better than 3 mm. Eight QSFP100 cages in two stacked rows of four columns (49 to 56), centred 190.9 to 247.9 mm on the registry's 19.0 mm pitch (the figure reads 191, 209, 230 and 245), between 9.96 and 24.16 mm down, as arista/7280tr3-40c6. The upper jack is the registry's mirror of the lower (turned 180), as that device; the QSFP rows are belly to belly, upper upright and lower turned 180, the library's convention, which the figure cannot confirm.

fru-bays.note: Guide Appendix E (E.2 power supplies, E.3 fan modules) and the data sheet ("1+1 hot-swappable"): THE TWO POWER SUPPLIES AND THE TWO FAN MODULES ARE BAYS. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit.

gate-1-front.note: Figure C-17 passes. The raster is 576 x 137 pixels; the body between its plate edges measures about 563 px wide and 57 px tall (aspect 9.9) against the data sheet's 440 / 43.7 = 10.07, so the figure is near-orthographic and carries geometry at about 1.277 px/mm (the 440 mm body is the scale anchor). One pixel is 0.8 mm, so every position is good to about 1 mm, and every one is `estimated` because it is read off a picture and no dimension states it. The RJ-45 jacks were read from the white port-number tabs of an enlargement at three times, the QSFP cages from theirs.

gate-1-rear.note: Figure D-3 as for arista/7050sx3-48yc8: the guide draws the rear generically (D-1 to D-4) and does not say which model uses which. The 7050TX3-48C8 is mapped to D-3 by its two fan modules (data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 2 (1+1 redundant)"), its 1RU height, its two power supplies and its management ports at the rear (Figure C-17 has none at the front). The data sheet (PDF page 3) captions one rear photograph for the 7050TX3-48C8 among others, two fan modules with a plate between, which agrees; the guide does not name the figure, so THE MAPPING IS ESTIMATED.

interface-names.note: Not printed and not modelled. EOS names ports Ethernet1 to Ethernet56 and Management1; this is the vendor's convention and no held document prints it.

lifecycle.note: Searched the held documents (the guide and the data sheet) for an end-of-sale or end-of-life notice for the 7050TX3-48C8: none. No web search was made, so this is a statement about those documents only.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. The guide's installation figures are isometric. Each carries an `empty` sentence. The guide's Table 5 gives this model KIT-GND-EXT-1RU on the bottom of the chassis; no figure measures it.

port-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.2 gives the port lamp states of the family, but Figure C-17 at 1.28 px/mm shows a line of small blue numbers under the jack rows and no per-port lamp that can be placed or counted. No port lamp is modelled (gap `port-lamps`).

port-numbering.note: Figure C-17 (callout 5, "Port numbers") prints 1 over 2, 3 over 4, and so on, 1 to 48 across the jack columns, and 49 over 50 to 55 over 56 across the QSFP columns, which sit between ports 24 and 25 in space and are numbered after 48. The odd number is the upper cage. The figure prints each number on a white tab outside its jack; a seated jack hides what is painted under it, so the numerals are set in the 3.5 mm band between the two rows, the odd number left of its column centre and the even one right of it. EOS interface names are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

port-speeds.note: Data sheet: "48x 1/2.5/5/10G-T" RJ-45 ports and "8x QSFP100". All forty-eight jacks are modelled at the highest native rate, 10G.

power.note: Guide Table 4: typical / maximum 212 W / 346 W with PWR-511-AC or PWR-511-DC. The data sheet prints the same, 212W / 346W ("measured at 25C ambient with 50% load on all ports, excludes transceivers"): the documents agree and there is no conflict.

rear.note: Figure D-3 as for arista/7050sx3-48yc8: PS1 left and PS2 right at 4.4 and 361.5 mm across, 73.5 mm wide; the management block a grey plate 82.5 to 100.5 mm across; two fan modules 78.6 mm wide at 105.7 and 276.6 mm; a grey plate between them printed with ASSY NUMBER, SERIAL NUMBER and MAC ADDRESS fields and PS1 and PS2 legends.

rear-fan.note: Data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 2 (1+1 redundant)", "Fan Tray FAN-7011M-F/R" and the spares FAN-7011M-F and FAN-7011M-R. The two fan modules are bays that accept FAN-7011M-F or -R; the -R configurations seat the blue modules. The components are the ones the 7280SR3-48YC8 seats, reused because the maker's part number is the same.

sources.note: 7050 Series 1RU (Gen 3) Quick Start Guide, Arista Networks, document DOC-00141-08, 57 pages, copyright 2025, PDF created 2025-08-19 (https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/qsg/qsg-books/QS_7050_1RU_Gen3.pdf): Table 1 (dimensions and weights), Table 2 (operating and storage), Table 3 (power input), Table 4 (power draw and supported supplies), section 2.1 (airflow orientation, handle colour), section 4.1 and Table 5 (grounding), Appendix C (Figure C-17, the front panel of the DCS-7050TX3-48C8), Appendix D (Figure D-3, the rear panel with management ports in the rear and two dual-fan modules), Appendix E (field replacement). 7050X3 Series 10/25/40/50/100G Data Center Switches Data Sheet, Arista Networks, 03-0040-46 (https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/Datasheets/7050X3-Datasheet.pdf): the model comparison, the power supply specifications and the ordering information. Held and checked first: intake COVERAGE.md and SOURCES.md, which list no photograph, 3D model or CAD file for this model (Arista publishes none; a `find` of the intake folder for 3D files found none) and a Visio stencil master that was not used. No drawing, photograph or logo is copied into the library, only transcribed facts and new drawings.

speed-strips.note: Figure C-17 draws a lavender band along the bottom of the QSFP block, 181.5 to 257.5 mm across, and a perforated grey panel between the two QSFP rows. The band is drawn in its colour and extent and its legends are not legible; the perforated panel is not drawn, because the numerals are set there.

status-lamps.note: Figure C-17 callouts 1 to 4: a system status lamp, a fan status lamp and a status lamp for each of the two power supplies, in a row at the top right with a symbol or legend above each; the guide's Appendix A.1.1 states the colours. Four lamps at 421.3, 426.0, 430.7 and 435.4 mm across and 4.4 mm down. The order (system, fan, PS1, PS2) is the callout order of the figure.

vents.note: The figure shows a perforated band along the top (0.3 to 8 mm down, from 28 mm across to the lamps) with a round knob at its left, and a row of slits along the bottom lip (about 41 mm down). Each is drawn in its measured extent, not hole by hole.
